subject: adding to a capture history file

messages.author: 5a91d3696b12d600
messages.subject: adding to a capture history file
parts:
I have 14 years of SCR data and I want to run some simulations based on a reduced trap array using closed robust design models .  I simulated a capture history file that I would like to add to my real capture history file so I can benefit from shared parameters (g0 and sigma) across years (i.e., sessions).  Since I am creating a new trap array to go with the simulated data, I cannot simply combine capture histories with the MS.capthist command in secr.  However, I have no raw input file for the simulated data so I cannot merge the raw input files and create a capture history file from that.  Is there any workaround to combining capture history data or to create an input file from a capture history file? Thanks!
Joe

Hi Joe
I'm sorry I don't see the problem. Pedantically: you mean capture history object, not file?. What am I not getting?
Murray

library(secr)
trps <- subset(traps(ovenCHp[[1]]), seq(2,44,2))
pop <- sim.popn(2, trps, 300)
ch <- sim.capthist(trps, pop)
ch2 <- MS.capthist(ovenCHp, ch)
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(ch2)
summary(ch2, terse = TRUE)

messages.subject: Re: adding to a capture history file
parts:
The help for MS.capthist is explicit:
"Each session may use a different detector array (traps) and a different number of sampling occasions."

But appears to contradict itself later:
"Sessions to be pooled must have the same number of capture occasions and use the same detectors (traps)"

That last bit applies to the rbind method for capthist objects:
rbind(ovenCHp[[1]], ch)
Error: varying numbers of occasions and/or detectors in rbind.capthist

I need to make that clear!
